title: MOQtail relay
description: A MOQtail relay's Prometheus metrics from /api/v1/metrics.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: The relay build, from moqtail_build_info.

panels.title: Objects out
panels.description: Objects written to subscribers per second, live and FETCH.

panels.title: Latency p99
panels.description: Time from an object's arrival to its write to a subscriber, 99th percentile. Values are histogram bucket bounds, so they are at most twice the real value.

panels.title: Errors / s
panels.description: Requests answered with an error, per second.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Object payload bytes per second.

panels.title: Objects dropped per second
panels.description: Objects not delivered to a subscriber: its queue was full, or the object outlived its delivery timeout.

panels.title: Processing time p99 by stage
panels.description: Ingest: read from the publisher to queued. Queue: waiting for the subscriber's task. Write: written to the subscriber's stream. Total: arrival to written.

panels.title: Processing time distribution, total
panels.description: Objects per processing-time bucket over time.

panels.title: Time to first object
panels.description: From a subscription's creation to its first object written.

panels.title: QUIC round-trip time
panels.description: Smoothed RTT across the open connections, at the median and 99th percentile.

panels.title: Connection failures per second
panels.description: Connections that failed before they became a session: at the handshake or SETUP. Empty until the first failure.

panels.title: QUIC packets lost
panels.description: Packets lost so far by the open connections.

panels.title: Requests per second by type
panels.description: Downstream: from clients to the relay. Upstream: from the relay to publishers and peers.

panels.title: Request errors per second by code
panels.description: REQUEST_ERROR codes in decimal: 16 is DOES_NOT_EXIST, 1 UNAUTHORIZED, 2 TIMEOUT, 3 NOT_SUPPORTED, 6 GOING_AWAY, 9 EXCESSIVE_LOAD.

panels.title: Upstream requests per second
panels.description: Requests the relay sent to publishers and cluster peers, by result.

panels.title: Limit rejections per second
panels.description: Requests refused or shed by a limit: draining, max_active_requests, max_publish_streams. Empty until the first rejection.

panels.title: Groups leaving the cache per second
panels.description: Expired: past their cache duration. Size: evicted to make room. Removed: removed or replaced.

panels.title: Throughput by zone
panels.description: Traffic per namespace prefix listed in accounting_zones. Empty without zones.

panels.title: Peer links
panels.description: Each peer this relay dials, by its configured URL: up while the link is open. Empty unless the relay has a hop_id or peers.

panels.title: Peer links over time
panels.description: 1 while the link to a configured peer is open, 0 while it is down.

panels.title: Peer sessions and adverts
panels.description: Open sessions with other relays, dialed by either side, and the namespaces this relay advertises to each peer.

panels.title: Resident memory
panels.description: Linux only.

panels.title: Open file descriptors
panels.description: Linux only.

panels.title: qlog events dropped
panels.description: qlog events the file writer could not keep up with.
